# Cursopus
> Personal job application tracker with AI assistance

Cursopus helps job seekers organize their job search with a Kanban-style board,
company management, an AI resume builder, an AI cover letter generator,
application stages, and analytics.

## Features
- Track job applications across customizable stages on a Kanban board
- Manage companies and contacts
- Build and tailor editable resumes with AI suggestions and PDF export
- Generate tailored cover letters with AI
- Analytics dashboard with job search insights
- Multi-language support (English, Russian, Ukrainian)

## Links
- Homepage: https://cursopus.com/
- Application tracker: https://cursopus.com/features/applications
- Resume builder: https://cursopus.com/features/resume-builder
- Cover letters: https://cursopus.com/features/cover-letters
- Blog: https://cursopus.com/blog

## Plans and AI use
- Free: 25 tracked jobs, 1 uploaded resume, 2 builder resumes, 1 cover letter and 30 AI credits once per account.
- Pro: $24 USD/month, 100 tracked jobs, 10 uploaded resumes, 10 builder resumes, 10 cover letters in total and 500 AI credits per confirmed paid period. No credit rollover.
- AI costs are shown before starting. Credit, input-size, availability and safety spending limits apply; AI can stop while credits remain. Review generated content; no hiring or ATS acceptance guarantee.
- Cursopus helps users track jobs they find. It is not a job board or recruiting service.

- Privacy: https://cursopus.com/privacy
- Refunds: https://cursopus.com/refund
